scope: Read-only diagnosis of Sol REP-001 ordinal 12, iteration 1. No historical artifact, runtime database, protocol, checker, or ledger was modified.

timeline.event: gpt-5.6-sol apply_patch tool call changed solver/Candidate.lean after that checker event
timeline.change: Two proof bodies totaling 28 old lines were replaced with two cases first <;> cases reply <;> decide lines.

timeline.event: agent final response claimed it was running the checker, but no subsequent checker tool call or event exists
evaluation and preserved workspace used the post-patch candidate
timeline.lean_result: failed because the replacement proofs require unavailable Decidable instances

cause.primary: The solver mutated Candidate.lean after its last recorded checker invocation.
cause.wrapper_order_defect: REP-001 called the upstream Phase2Runner.run_single first, allowing agent, evaluation, and result finalization to complete before the observer compared the final candidate to the last checker event.
cause.audit_surface_defect: The observer raised before solver_rollout_completed, and the upstream batch runner caught and skipped the task. The auditor then reported generic incomplete rollout telemetry instead of a protocol-owned terminal rejection.

repair_boundary.wrapper_owned_terminal_checker: Invoke the exact immutable checker after _run_agent returns and before evaluate_workspace starts, then revalidate that candidate/checker/evidence snapshot after evaluation.
repair_boundary.terminal_event: Emit exactly one solver_rollout_terminal event for every rollout, including explicit RUN_FAILED_CHECK_EVIDENCE_CONTRACT rejection.
repair_boundary.optimizer_safety: A rejected rollout must never produce an optimizer candidate.
repair_boundary.auditor_behavior: Validate terminal-event completeness and classify explicit checker-evidence rejection instead of collapsing it to missing rollout telemetry.
repair_boundary.unchanged_inputs: Tasks, cases, matrix order, seeds, conditions, prompts, initial guidance, checker bytes, evaluator, Lean source, model, reasoning effort, turn budget, timeout, and retry/resume/import policy remain unchanged.

claim_boundary: This diagnosis identifies the preserved ordinal-12 evidence-order cause and a prospective zero-model repair. It does not repair or reclassify REP-001, authorize REP-002 model calls, or establish a complete cross-model comparison.
